_description: Standalone config for analysis/fit_2rc_pulse.py. Every key is optional; omitted keys fall back to the module defaults shown here. Pass with `python -m analysis.fit_2rc_pulse <pulse.parquet> --config <this.json>`.
_soc_comment: SOC-sweep labeling. Pulses are grouped into plateaus by Ah_throughput: a jump > plateau_gap_ah (the between-plateau step) starts the next plateau. soc_sweep_direction is the SWEEP direction (not a single pulse's CHA/DCH): 'discharge' -> SOC 100% at the top plateau, stepping down soc_step_pct each plateau; 'charge' -> SOC 0% at the bottom plateau, stepping up. plateau_gap_ah null -> derived as nom_capacity * soc_step_pct / 100 (one full SOC step in Ah).
